name: Maxxus S-Line Yoga 1-Person Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna
description: Looking for a personal wellness retreat that fits effortlessly into your home? The 2024 Maxxus S-Line 1-Person Ultra-Low EMF Far Infrared Sauna (MX-S106-01) combines modern design with advanced infrared technology to deliver a relaxing and restorative experience. Crafted from sustainably sourced Canadian Hemlock, it’s built for both durability and elegance, making it a natural fit for any interior space. This compact sauna features seven PureTech™ ultra-low EMF carbon heaters positioned on all four walls for consistent, gentle heat. The easy-remove bench allows space for yoga or stretching, while amenities like interior chromotherapy lighting with red light therapy, a tempered glass door, Bluetooth/MP3 speakers, and LED controls elevate your sessions. With its plug-and-play 120V/15A setup and simple clasp-together assembly, you can enjoy the health benefits of infrared therapy in the comfort of your own home-without the hassle. Features: 1 person capacity 7 Maxxus Low EMF (EMF between 5-10MG - 2 to 3 inches from the heating panels) FAR Infrared Carbon heating panels Natural Reforested Canadian Hemlock wood construction Clear Tempered glass door Interior chromotherapy lighting system with Red Light Feature Interior LED Control Panel Bluetooth and MP3 auxiliary connection with built in speakers 118F-132F is the ideal temperature range, sauna can heat up to 140F Clasp together assembly Indoor Use Only Canadian Hemlock construction made from reforested wood Easy‑remove bench ideal for yoga or stretching Integrated Bluetooth/MP3 audio with built-in speakers Roof vent for fresh airflow Ships in 2 boxes Specifications: Capacity 1 person Exterior (W×D×H) 39" × 36" × 75" Interior (W×D×H) 35" × 32" × 68" Wood Canadian Reforested Hemlock Heating Panels 7 PureTech™ ultra‑low EMF carbon heaters Assembly Clasp‑together; ships in 2 boxes Electrical 120 V/15 A plug & play (dedicated recommended) Ventilation Roof vent Weight Sauna: 250 lb; Shipping: 300 lb Document: View Owner's Manual
